narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On October 3, 2023, at approximately 2330 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stopped a pickup truck on US-23 near Ann Arbor, Michigan, after it was observed travelling in tandem with a vehicle previously linked to smuggling. Three men were in the truck. The agents identified themselves and questioned each occupant separately.
The subject, who was seated in the front passenger seat, stated that he is a citizen of Mexico, that he has no immigration documents, and that he crossed the border illegally near Nogales, Arizona, on or about August 20, 2015. He had no identity documents. The driver and the rear-seat passenger declined to answer questions and were processed separately.
TRAVEL:
The subject stated that after crossing he lived in Arizona for several years before moving to Michigan in 2021.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
All three men were transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station. The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear and detained.
